title: Problem
description: Structured application failure whose stable classification determines the process exit status.

kind.description: Stable discriminator for a VoidTrace application failure.

message.description: Non-empty diagnostic suitable for a human or agent.

classification.description: Stable failure class that determines the process exit status.

pointer.description: Optional JSON Pointer locating the rejected input.

mechanicId.description: Optional stable identifier of the unsupported or failed mechanic.

causeCode.description: Optional stable code from the delegated application failure.

source.description: Optional non-empty source identifier associated with input loading.
